## What's new

- PT's Grid now shows on the Game Boy Advance at Integer. The Brick draws a GBA at 4x, where the old default line width fell between screen pixels and the Grid drew nothing. A GBA's recommended Grid Line Width is now 30%, which looks like the Game Boy's at its 5x. Reset to Recommended on the GBA's shader page brings it in if you've changed your settings.
- ChaOS-diatom 0.9.4.

---

ChaOS 1.0.0 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v1.0.0-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.1.1](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.1.1) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v1.0.0-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
